issues.message: The client resolves the KeyframeSequence by looking it up under ReplicatedStorage/Forge_8a81efe9b8ed/Assets/punchAnim/..., but the retained component's destinationPath for the punch animation is under ReplicatedStorage. That path is not declared in the scene export, so the lookup can wait forever. The `task.spawn` WaitForChild calls have no timeout or diagnostic. If the sequence never replicates, punches fire with no animation and nothing reports why. Native Play must confirm that the sequence exists on the client and that RegisterKeyframeSequence succeeds there.

The animation is only loaded if the Humanoid exists when the sequence resolves. The load runs again from the registration thread, but `onCharacterAdded` calls `WaitForChild('Humanoid')` and this can race with the registration thread. There is also no Animator wait, so the Animator that is created on the client may not replicate. The punch track has Action priority but is never given an explicit priority or a Stopped/Ended handler. The animation is Studio-only and cannot be published, which is a known limitation.

The approved sound runs roughly 1.5s, longer than the 0.5s cooldown. The server reuses one Sound instance and calls Play() on it, which restarts the clip on rapid hits and cuts off the previous impact. The original Assets/hitSound node is never used. Audibility is not verified by any playback check.

Hit detection is a server distance check from HumanoidRootPart to the Head/Torso positions within 8 studs. It ignores facing direction, so the player can punch with their back to the dummy and still score. It does not use the punching hand as the approved mechanics describe. The cooldown also starts on a miss, which is acceptable under the stated limits.

The dummy contains a Respawn script which the approved source review marked for disabling. Neither DummySetup nor the retained export shows it being disabled. The script clones its parent and replaces it when Humanoid.Health drops below 1. The dummy also sits at z=15, while the Ground part spans z=-7 to 17. The ground is 24x24 with no walls or boundary markers, so the enclosed 20x20 room is not built. The mat theme is only weakly expressed, and the Torso Decal media is unverified.

The counter is only updated by CounterUpdated events. A one-off FireClient may arrive before the HUD LocalScript connects, and the HUD sits in StarterGui, so the ScreenGui is built when the script runs. The counter always resets to 0 on load. The HUD script is placed directly under a StarterGui folder, which can cause duplicate-HUD problems on respawn. The existing-HUD reuse guard may leave the OnClientEvent connection duplicated.

The environment needs enclosing walls or boundary markers and a mat floor. The ground is a gray slab of material 1312 with only light fixtures. This was not requested as a change in this pass, but it is unmet.

tests.source:
return function(ctx)
	local root = workspace:WaitForChild(ctx.scope)
	local m = root:WaitForChild('Assets'):WaitForChild('dummy'):WaitForChild('dummy'):WaitForChild('Training Dummy')
	assert(m:IsA('Model'), 'dummy model missing')
	local head = m:FindFirstChild('Head')
	local torso = m:FindFirstChild('Torso')
	assert(head and head:IsA('BasePart'), 'Head hitbox missing')
	assert(torso and torso:IsA('BasePart'), 'Torso hitbox missing')
	for _, d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA('BasePart') then
			assert(d.Anchored, 'dummy part not anchored: ' .. d:GetFullName())
		end
	end
end

return function(ctx)
	local root = workspace:WaitForChild(ctx.scope)
	local m = root.Assets.dummy.dummy['Training Dummy']
	local p = m:GetPivot().Position
	assert((p - Vector3.new(0, 3, 15)).Magnitude < 4, 'dummy not near (0,3,15)')
	local ground = root.World.Ground
	assert(ground.CanCollide and ground.Anchored, 'ground not walkable')
	assert(root.World:FindFirstChild('Spawn'), 'spawn missing')
end

return function(ctx)
	local rs = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):WaitForChild(ctx.scope)
	local remotes = require(rs:WaitForChild('PunchRemotes'))
	assert(remotes.PunchAttempt:IsA('RemoteEvent'), 'PunchAttempt missing')
	assert(remotes.CounterUpdated:IsA('RemoteEvent'), 'CounterUpdated missing')
	local cfg = require(rs:WaitForChild('PunchConfig'))
	assert(cfg.CooldownSeconds > 0 and cfg.MaxRangeStuds > 0, 'config invalid')
end

return function(ctx)
	local s = workspace:WaitForChild(ctx.scope):WaitForChild('Assets'):WaitForChild('hitSound')
	assert(s:IsA('Sound'), 'hitSound is not a Sound')
	assert(s.SoundId == 'rbxassetid://126976659766267', 'wrong approved sound id')
	assert(not s.Looped, 'sound must not loop')
end

return function(ctx)
	local rs = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
	local cur = rs:WaitForChild(ctx.scope, 10)
	assert(cur, 'namespace missing on client')
	for _, n in ipairs({'Assets','punchAnim','punchAnim','punching animation 1','AnimSaves','punching animation'}) do
		cur = cur:WaitForChild(n, 10)
		assert(cur, 'missing path segment on client: ' .. n)
	end
	assert(cur:IsA('KeyframeSequence'), 'not a KeyframeSequence')
	local id = game:GetService('KeyframeSequenceProvider'):RegisterKeyframeSequence(cur)
	assert(type(id) == 'string' and #id > 0, 'registration failed')
	local player = game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer
	local hum = (player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()):WaitForChild('Humanoid')
	assert(hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15, 'rig not R15')
	local anim = Instance.new('Animation')
	anim.AnimationId = id
	local animator = hum:WaitForChild('Animator')
	local track = animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
	track:Play()
	task.wait(0.1)
	assert(track.IsPlaying, 'punch track not playing')
	track:Stop()
end

return function(ctx)
	local pg = game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer:WaitForChild('PlayerGui')
	local gui = pg:WaitForChild('HitCounterHUD', 10)
	assert(gui and gui:IsA('ScreenGui'), 'HUD missing')
	assert(gui.ResetOnSpawn == false, 'HUD resets on spawn')
	local frame = gui:WaitForChild('CounterFrame')
	assert(frame:IsA('Frame'), 'frame missing')
	local label = frame:WaitForChild('CounterLabel')
	assert(label:IsA('TextLabel'), 'label missing')
	assert(frame.AnchorPoint == Vector2.new(1, 0), 'not top-right anchored')
	assert(label.Text:match('^Hits: %d+$'), 'unexpected label text')
	local n = 0
	for _, c in ipairs(pg:GetChildren()) do
		if c.Name == 'HitCounterHUD' then n += 1 end
	end
	assert(n == 1, 'duplicate HUD')
end

return function(ctx)
	local rs = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):WaitForChild(ctx.scope)
	local remotes = require(rs:WaitForChild('PunchRemotes'))
	local player = game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer
	local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	local root = char:WaitForChild('HumanoidRootPart')
	local dummy = workspace[ctx.scope].Assets.dummy.dummy['Training Dummy']
	local target = dummy:GetPivot().Position + Vector3.new(0, 0, -4)
	char:PivotTo(CFrame.new(target.X, 3, target.Z))
	task.wait(0.5)
	local pg = player:WaitForChild('PlayerGui')
	local label = pg:WaitForChild('HitCounterHUD'):WaitForChild('CounterFrame'):WaitForChild('CounterLabel')
	local before = tonumber(label.Text:match('%d+')) or 0
	remotes.PunchAttempt:FireServer()
	task.wait(1)
	local after = tonumber(label.Text:match('%d+')) or 0
	assert(after == before + 1, 'counter did not increment by exactly 1 on a hit')
	remotes.PunchAttempt:FireServer()
	remotes.PunchAttempt:FireServer()
	task.wait(1)
	local spam = tonumber(label.Text:match('%d+')) or 0
	assert(spam - after <= 1, 'cooldown allowed duplicate hits in one window')
end

return function(ctx)
	local root = workspace:WaitForChild(ctx.scope)
	local w = root:WaitForChild('World')
	assert(w:FindFirstChild('Ground'), 'floor missing')
	local lights = w:WaitForChild('Lighting')
	local n = 0
	for _, d in ipairs(lights:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA('PointLight') then n += 1 end
	end
	assert(n >= 1, 'no lighting present')
end

return function(ctx)
	local assets = workspace:WaitForChild(ctx.scope):WaitForChild('Assets'):WaitForChild('dummy')
	local count = 0
	for _, d in ipairs(assets:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA('Model') and d.Name == 'Training Dummy' then count += 1 end
	end
	assert(count == 1, 'expected exactly one dummy, got ' .. count)
end

return function(ctx)
	local root = workspace:WaitForChild(ctx.scope)
	local humanoids = 0
	for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA('Humanoid') and d.Parent and d.Parent.Name == 'Training Dummy' then humanoids += 1 end
	end
	assert(humanoids <= 1, 'more than one dummy humanoid')
end
